product.schneider-386-professional-340.s: The 25 MHz Professional with the 340 sales designation.
product.schneider-386-professional-340.h: The June 1989 German list advertised the 386-340/25 for DM 19,990 net.
product.schneider-386-professional-340.t: Disk capacity changed between lists. June 1989 lists 319 MB, December 1989 lists 333 MB and December 1990 lists 334 MB. Both December entries specify SCSI.
The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
The board still needs to be matched, an attributable BIOS needs preservation and an image with clear publication rights remains pending.
